summary: Deployed and served the inventory application on node1 over TCP 8181 (Apache vhost) while keeping SELinux enforcing, by labeling the content httpd_sys_content_t and adding an SELinux port mapping (8181→http_port_t) plus a firewalld rule instead of relaxing SELinux. Verified HTTP 200 reachability via NODE_IP and absence of AVC denials. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/service/enforcing baseline, rebooted node1 with systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified SELinux enforcing, httpd/firewalld active, port 8181 listening, app returning HTTP 200, firewall rule persisted, and no AVC denials post-reboot.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: SELinux Enforcing, no httpd/nginx installed, no existing inventory app (cmd-7f3421cc24984371, cmd-fd1e8d3bf48d4e77)
Confirmed root/sudo access and dnf availability (cmd-f7bf6cba46a74087)
Installed httpd and policycoreutils-python-utils (cmd-f563e59dfa174991, cmd-27895523643d4d9e, cmd-f925efefe09e4a38)
Created /var/www/inventory/index.html inventory app content with correct httpd_sys_content_t SELinux context (cmd-8dfbb80d60d14cd0)
Created Apache vhost /etc/httpd/conf.d/inventory.conf listening on port 8181 (cmd-a7312b16c2a74f7e)
Added SELinux port mapping 8181/tcp to http_port_t via semanage (cmd-3cb78ac71fc847b5)
Opened firewalld port 8181/tcp permanently and reloaded (cmd-d8d4408854b445f0)
Verified SELinux Enforcing, port 8181 listening, HTTP 200 via NODE_IP, no AVC denials (cmd-453008bb1c254a3e)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service baseline (cmd-44bb1b15159d464a)
Triggered systemctl reboot with backgrounded ack (cmd-b68f6c5d59664797)
Polled node1 until it reconnected after reboot (cmd-1853e9bc7fb74f8d, cmd-86cf594a26704e59, cmd-eb8633baabf847ed, cmd-d7c2e4a3ab7a48e5)
Verified changed boot_id and full post-reboot recovery: SELinux Enforcing, httpd/firewalld active, port 8181 listening, HTTP 200, firewall rule persisted, no AVC denials (cmd-8e2f83cfc4a74e9f)

evidence.requirement: Inventory application served over TCP 8181 on node1
evidence.summary: Deployed inventory content, configured Apache vhost on 8181, started httpd, and confirmed HTTP 200 response and listening socket on port 8181

evidence.requirement: Mandatory access control (SELinux) remains enforcing throughout
evidence.summary: SELinux was Enforcing at baseline, kept enforcing by adding a proper port label (not by disabling/permissive mode), and confirmed still Enforcing with no AVC denials both before and after restart
Captured pre-restart boot_id, Enforcing SELinux state, active httpd/firewalld, and working HTTP 200 response on 8181

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: restart acknowledgement and reconnection
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; polling showed connection loss during reboot and successful reconnection afterward

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity and recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e to cde81f76-43e8-4c1a-be60-29abed87703e; post-reboot verification shows SELinux Enforcing, httpd/firewalld active, port 8181 listening, HTTP 200 on inventory app, firewall rule persisted, and no AVC denials
